# YURI NO1

> YURI NO1 (also known as YURI1) is a public Girls' Love (Yuri) mixed-media fiction website with AI-expanded novels and human prompts. Reader pages use JavaScript; the same published content is also available as public JSON.

## Machine-readable access

- Reader URL pattern: `https://www.yuri1.com/post.html?id=<PUBLIC_ID>`
- Canonical catalog: [w-catalog.json](https://www.yuri1.com/codex-w/w-catalog.json)
- Tag index: [w-tag.json](https://www.yuri1.com/codex-w/w-tag.json)
- Content files: `https://www.yuri1.com/codex-text/<STORAGE_ID>.json`
- The entries below map each public reader ID directly to its public JSON content. The JSON and reader represent the same published work/data.
- Content is public and may include material marked up to 16+; see the site Content Rating Guide and AI & Content Policy for details.
